title: 户外游乐设备基础

intro.visual: 绿野寻踪大型玩具 + 托育滑梯 + 攀爬网
intro.background: 户外大型游乐设备是温尚的高毛利产品线。我们有多个主题系列：绿野寻踪（森林探险主题）、童话森林（彩虹滑梯主题）、树屋攀爬（Treehouse Climbing）、松鼠乐园（整园系列）、大自然的密语。托育滑梯系列有标准SKU，如086-DX37（450×210×290cm，适合3-15岁）、087-DX40萝卜小屋（750×250×350cm）。结构材质：樟子松实木+热镀锌钢管+PE板+抗UV尼龙绳网。非标定制是核心竞争力——客户给场地照片，我们5个工作日出3D效果图。
intro.desc: 掌握温尚户外产品线、主题系列、材质规格和非标定制流程。
tasks: 掌握4种结构材质及规格
outcomes: 能介绍户外产品线和主题系列
能描述设备材质和规格参数
能引导客户做非标定制

oneLiner.en: Outdoor playgrounds are custom-engineered structures — every slide length, climbing net and fall height must comply with EN1176. Our themed series include Forest Adventure, Fairy Tale Forest and Treehouse Climbing.
oneLiner.cn: 户外游乐设备是定制工程结构——每个滑梯长度、攀爬网、下落高度都必须符合EN1176。我们的主题系列包括绿野寻踪、童话森林和树屋攀爬。

vocab.ex: Our Forest Adventure themed structure combines slides, climbing nets and treehouses.
vocab.exCn: 我们的绿野寻踪主题设施融合了滑梯、攀爬网和树屋。

vocab.ex: Model 086-DX37 is a combination slide measuring 450 by 210 by 290 centimeters.
The climbing net is made of UV-resistant nylon rope with galvanized steel frames.
vocab.exCn: 攀爬网用抗紫外线尼龙绳配镀锌钢管框架。

vocab.ex: Our Treehouse Climbing series lets kids climb a wooden spiral staircase and slide through a tunnel.
vocab.exCn: 我们的树屋攀爬系列让孩子爬木质螺旋楼梯，从钻筒滑下。

vocab.ex: The main frame is hot-dip galvanized steel, anti-rust for 10 years outdoors.
vocab.exCn: 主框架是热镀锌钢管，户外10年防锈。

vocab.ex: PE panels are colorfast, UV-resistant and easy to clean.
vocab.exCn: PE板色牢度高、抗紫外线、易清洁。

vocab.ex: The maximum fall height is 1.5 meters, well within EN1176 limits.
vocab.exCn: 最大下落高度1.5米，完全在EN1176限值内。

vocab.ex: We recommend pouring EPDM rubber surfacing under all play equipment.
vocab.exCn: 我们建议所有游乐设备下浇筑EPDM橡胶地面。

mistakes.wrong: Our slide is very safe and fun.
mistakes.right: Our combination slide complies with EN1176-1:2017, with a fall height of 1.5 meters, hot-dip galvanized frame and EPDM surfacing below.
mistakes.cn: 错误：只说安全好玩。客户要的是标准号、下落高度、材质和缓冲地面。

mistakes.wrong: We can make any design you want.
mistakes.right: We offer non-standard customization: send us your site dimensions or photos, and our design team will produce a 3D rendering within 5 working days, with up to 3 revision rounds.
mistakes.cn: 错误：只说什么都能做。要说明定制流程：场地资料→5天出3D→3轮修改→确认方案。

basic.en: Our Forest Adventure series is our best-selling themed structure.
basic.cn: 绿野寻踪系列是我们最畅销的主题设施。

basic.en: The main frame is hot-dip galvanized steel.
The wood parts are natural Mongolian Scotch pine.
basic.cn: 木质部分是天然樟子松。

basic.en: It complies with EN1176 safety standard.
We can customize the design based on your site.
basic.cn: 我们可以根据您的场地定制设计。

basic.en: We recommend EPDM safety surfacing underneath.
basic.cn: 我们建议下方做EPDM安全地垫。

advanced.en: This Forest Adventure unit features a hot-dip galvanized steel frame, natural Scotch pine platforms, 304 stainless steel slides, UV-stabilized PE panels and a nylon rope climbing net — fully certified to EN1176 by TUV, with a maximum fall height of 1.5 meters.
advanced.cn: 这套绿野寻踪设施采用热镀锌钢架、天然樟子松平台、304不锈钢滑梯、抗UV PE板和尼龙绳攀爬网——TUV全项EN1176认证，最大下落高度1.5米。
advanced.from: The main frame is hot-dip galvanized steel.

advanced.en: Our non-standard customization process takes 5 working days for a 3D rendering: you send site photos and dimensions, we assign a dedicated designer, deliver the first rendering, and include up to 3 revision rounds before final confirmation and quotation.
advanced.cn: 我们的非标定制流程5个工作日出3D效果图：您发场地照片和尺寸，我们指派专属设计师，出第一版效果图，包含最多3轮修改，然后确认方案并报价。
advanced.from: We can customize the design based on your site.

dialogues.title: 客户询价户外主题设备

lines.speaker: client
lines.en: We need a play structure for our new kindergarten. Do you have themed designs?
lines.cn: 我们新幼儿园需要一套游乐设施。你们有主题设计吗？

lines.speaker: you
lines.en: Yes, we have several themed series. Our most popular is Forest Adventure — it combines treehouses, rope bridges, climbing nets and stainless steel slides. We also have Fairy Tale Forest with rainbow slides, and Treehouse Climbing for older kids.
lines.cn: 有的，我们有多个主题系列。最受欢迎的是绿野寻踪——融合树屋、绳网桥、攀爬网和不锈钢滑梯。还有彩虹滑梯的童话森林，和适合大孩子的树屋攀爬。

lines.speaker: client
lines.en: The yard is about 180 square meters, kids aged 3 to 6. Can you design something for us?
lines.cn: 场地约180平米，3-6岁。能为我们设计吗？

lines.speaker: you
lines.en: Absolutely. For 180 sqm and ages 3-6, I recommend a customized Forest Adventure unit with a 3-meter slide, climbing net and a small playhouse. Send us your site photos and dimensions, and we will deliver a 3D rendering within 5 working days. Main frame is galvanized steel, EN1176 certified.
lines.cn: 当然。180平米、3-6岁，我推荐定制绿野寻踪主题：3米滑梯+攀爬网+小游戏屋。发您场地照片和尺寸，我们5个工作日出3D效果图。主架镀锌钢，EN1176认证。

scenario.q: A customer wants a play structure for a 200 sqm kindergarten yard, ages 3-6, with a forest theme. How do you respond professionally?
scenario.modelAnswer: For a 200 sqm forest-themed yard, I recommend our customized Forest Adventure unit with a 3-meter stainless steel slide, a rope climbing net, two treehouse platforms and a small play tunnel. The main frame is hot-dip galvanized steel, wood parts are natural Scotch pine, PE panels are UV-stabilized — all EN1176 certified with a 1.5m fall height. Send us your site photos and dimensions, and we will deliver a 3D rendering within 5 working days with up to 3 revisions. Shall I prepare the proposal and quotation?
scenario.cn: 200平米森林主题场地，我推荐定制绿野寻踪主题：3米不锈钢滑梯+绳网攀爬+两个树屋平台+小游戏钻筒。主架热镀锌钢，木质天然樟子松，PE板抗UV——全项EN1176认证，下落高度1.5米。发您场地照片和尺寸，我们5个工作日出3D效果图，含3轮修改。我准备方案和报价？

checklist: 我能说出5大主题系列名称
我能描述镀锌钢/樟子松/PE板/尼龙绳网4种材质
我知道EN1176是户外安全标准
我能说出非标定制6步流程
我知道要推荐EPDM缓冲地面
我能根据面积和年龄段推荐设备组合

culture.title: 非标定制是教玩具外贸的核心竞争力
culture.content: 和标准品不同，户外游乐设备几乎都是一园一设计。客户买的不是SKU，而是我们家幼儿园独一无二的设备。流程：客户发场地照片/平面图→你问面积、年龄段、主题偏好→设计师出3D效果图→客户改3轮→确认方案→报价→签合同→生产→海运→现场安装。周期通常2-4个月。会做3D设计、能用英语解释设计理念的业务员，客单价能翻倍。温尚的绿野寻踪、童话森林、树屋攀爬三大系列是主推款，要熟记。
